Invisible Boyfriend

By: Jo Munnik | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
What you can do on social media knows no bounds.. One of the latest attractions is an app called Invisible Boyfriend - you can create your designer invisible boyfriend who does not exist.

Summary:
PROPOSAL – INVISIBLE BOYFRIEND – 02 JULY 2015

The online world has totally changed how we date with the introduction of tinder, Grindr, Facebook and most recently invisible boyfriend and girlfriend.

A dating app that allows you to create a fake partner who will text you, flirt with you and make others believe that you do in fact have a significant other.

"Are you LGBT? Deployed overseas? Focusing on a promotion? An invisible boyfriend can help you manage real-world distractions," reads the FAQ section at invisibleboyfriend.com. "put simply, this platform helps you create credible, reasonable stories that you can bring home to curious mom, your buddies, and coworkers. These stories are backed by virtual and real-world social proof."

Essentially, you create your own partner — everything from their name, age and where they live to their interests, character traits, and how they interact with you.The relationships offered up by these apps may be 100 per cent fake, but it's important to note that there will be a working human behind every text message, voicemail and social media post users receive from their invisible partners.

For $25 you get 100 text messages, 10 voice mails and one handwritten note.



Further information:
So why would you want an invisible girlfriend or boyfriend?

Invisible Girlfriend and Invisible Boyfriend are the result of one man’s frustration, and a little bit of desperation. Co-founder Matt Homann was newly divorced and tired of feeling pressured to jump into something new. "Around Thanksgiving, my mom called me and asked if she should set an extra place for someone I’m bringing,” Matt recalls. “In that moment I realized how great it would be to have an answer for her that didn’t require me to actually be dating someone.”
He figured he wasn't alone in that, and Invisible Girlfriend and Invisible Boyfriend was born.

But beyond that, Invisible Boyfriend caters to people who don't want their conservative grandparents to find out that they're gay. Others are soldiers overseas who want to pretend they have girlfriends back home. A few others have been guys who want to practice having a girlfriend so they can see what it's like, and so they can learn how to flirt over text messages. That way, if they ever meet an actual woman, they will know what to do when it comes to texting and leaving voice mail messages and other things that people who have real boyfriends and girlfriends do. (Because, in fact, there are people who do not know how to do this)

Press Release:


Invisible Partner
Tired of being single and feeling lonely? Imagine being able to design your perfect partner - someone attentive, affectionate, expressive, who happily interacts with you all day long. What if you could choose their name, their looks, their personality and even write the passionate story of your first meeting. Carte Blanche explores the invisible boyfriend


Script:


OPENING GRAPHIC: MESSAGES INTERCUT WITH DEREK LINK.

SENDER
HI BABE.. JUST THINKING OF YOU.. WHAT YOU UP TO?
RECEIVER
THINKING OF YOU TOO.. HOPE THAT MEETING WENT WELL..
SENDER
IT DID THANK YOU. WE STILL ON FOR DINNER TONIGHT?
DEREK LINK
IT LOOKS LIKE SHE’S MESSAGING HER BOYFRIEND. WELL IN A WAY SHE IS. THE BIGGEST DIFFERENCE IS, HE’S INVISIBLE.

VOICE OVER:
INVISIBLE BOYFRIEND OR GIRLFRIEND IS A SERVICE THAT LETS YOU DESIGN AND INTERACT WITH YOUR PERFECT VIRTUAL PARTNER..

THEY DESCRIBE THEMSELVES AS BEING - THE BOYFRIEND OR GIRLFRIEND YOU’VE ALWAYS WANTED. SOMEONE WHO ASKS ABOUT YOUR DAY AND ALWAYS RESPONDS. SOMEONE WHO HAPPENS TO HAVE ALL OF THE SAME INTERESTS AS YOU. THE PERSON OF YOUR DREAMS.

IT WAS CREATED BY AMERICAN DIGITAL ENTREPRENEUR MATTHEW HOMANN.


MATTHEW HOMANN

DEREK:
MATT THERE IS A PERSONAL STORY BEHIND THIS, YOU HAD RECENTLY GOT DIVORCED.

MATT:
WHEN I WAS DIVORCED …. I REALISED HOW MANY PEOPLE WERE JUDGING ME BASED ON MY RELATIONSHIP STATUS. ASKING IF THEY CAN SET ME UP WITH SOMEONE..

VOICE OVER:
AND MATTHEW IS NOT ALONE IN THIS REGARD.. MANY PEOPLE FEEL PRESSURIZED TO BE SEEN TO BE IN A RELATIONSHIP. ENTER : INVISIBLE BOYFRIEND AND GIRLFRIEND WHICH LAUNCHED IN THE USA AND CANADA JANUARY 2015. TO DATE IT HAS OFFERED ALMOST 90 000 SUBSCRIBERS SO-CALLED SOCIAL PROOF THAT THEY ARE NOW ATTACHED.

MATTHEW HOMANN
SO WHEN WE TALK ABOUT SOCIAL PROOF HANDFUL OF THINGS THAT BECOME THAT PROOF FOR OTHERS, THE PICTURE, THE NOTES THE TEXT MESSAGES .

VOICE OVER
ACCORDING TO CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST VUYO TEMBA INVISIBLE BOYFRIEND MAY BE ONTO SOMETHING..

VUYO TEMBA
WELL, WHEN I FIRST HEARD ABOUT IT SOUNDED VERY ABSURD. BUT AS I THOUGHT ABOUT IT I THOUGHT THERE COULD BE MERIT TO IT. THE IDEA OF CHOICES.. TO BE ABLE TO SAY – THIS IS THE KIND OF PERSON I WANT, THIS IS HOW I WANT THEM TO LOOK LIKE.

VOICE OVER
THE SERVICE ALSO LENDS ITSELF TO PEOPLE WHO NEED A LITTLE PRACTICE WHEN IT COMES TO THE RULES OF ATTRACTION..

VUYO TEMBA
I MEAN THE PEOPLE WHO ARE PROBABLY USING IT IS AS A TEST GROUND. SO YOU DO HAVE YOUR 40 YEAR OLD VIRGINS WHO HAVE NEVER BEEN IN A RELATIONSHIP SO THEY DON’T EVEN KNOW WHERE TO START.. … I THINK IT IS A NICE PLATFORM TO JUST PRACTICE, USE IT ..

VO:
BUT IT’S NOT JUST FOR THE 40 YEAR OLD VIRGIN MANY OF THE SUBSCRIBERS INCLUDE GAY PEOPLE WHO ARE NOT READY TO DISCLOSE THEIR STATUS AND SOLDIERS WHO HAVE BEEN DEPLOYED ABROAD.

THE YOUNG AND TRENDY ARE ALSO SIGNING UP. ZAKARA’S CURIOSITY GOT THE BETTER OF HER WHEN WE ASKED HER TO TEST DRIVE IT. WHILE IT’S NOT YET AVAILABLE IN SOUTH AFRICA, WE WERE GIVEN SPECIAL ACCESS TO INVISIBLE BOYFRIEND FOR THE PURPOSE OF THIS STORY.

ZAKARA – DIARY CAM
IT’S A BIT EASIER CHATTING TO SOMEONE VIA TEXT MESSAGE THAN A REAL LIFE FIRST DATE BECAUSE YOU DON’T HAVE TO BE ALL DOLLED UP OR WORRY ABOUT YOUR POSTURE OR HOW YOUR FACE IS MOVING.. YOU JUST HAVE TO COMPOSE SENTENCES, WHICH IS QUITE SIMPLE..

DEREK LINK
ZAKARA PUT THE SERVICE TO THE TEST AND I EVEN GOT TO HELP HER TO CREATE THE PERFECT BOYFREND.

SEQUENCE: CREATING THE PERFECT BOYFRIEND : ROY ROGERS.

DEREK
MATT IT’S NOT FOR FREE, WHAT ARE THE COSTS..

MATTHEW HOMANN
LOOKING AT $ 19.99 GIVES YOU VOICE MAIL, HAND WRITTEN NOTES AND TEXT MESSAGES.
PEOPLE KEEP RE-SUBSCRIBING TO THE SERVICE.

ZAKARA DIARY CAM
I’LL SHOW YOU SOME OF THE MESSAGES HE SENT. WE HAD A BIT OF A CONVERSATION THIS MORNING.

MESSAGES – GRAPHICS WITH ZACH NARRATING

ZAKARA DIARY CAM
SO WE STARTED OUR CONVERSATION THIS MORNING AND HE STARTED OUT WITH A CLASSIC, HEY ZAKARA THIS IS ROY, HOW ARE YOU. TODAY IS MY FIRST DAY AT MY NEW JOB AND HE SAID DON’T WORRY, DON’T’ BE SCARED.. IT’S NICE TO HAVE THAT SUPPORT.

MATTHEW
…. ALWAYS POSITIVE, ALWAYS VALIDATING.

TOBY SHAPSHAK
I THINK IT’S TERRIBLE IDEA. MY HEART DESPAIRS.

VOICE OVER
BUT NOT EVERYONE IS CONVINCED - LIKE THE EDITOR OF TECHNOLOGY MAGAZINE ‘STUFF’ MAGAZINE. TOBY SHAPSHAK.

TOBY SHAPSHAK
I UNDERSTAND THAT FOR SOME PEOPLE THAT FOR SOME PEOPLE THAT KIND OF CONTACT WOULD BE REALLY GREAT.

BUT I THINK WE ARE ALREADY TENDING TOWARDS HAVING LESS AND LESS HUMAN CONTACT AND I JUST DESPAIR THAT, THAT IS WHAT PEOPLE WILL DO. THEY WILL BECOME ACCUSTOMED TO IT AND NEVER GO OUT.

IT IS SO TRAGIC THAT THAT IS WHAT PEOPLE WOULD CONSIDER TO BE MEANINGFUL INTERACTION. I MEAN YOU ARE BASICALLY CHATTING TO SOMEONE IN A CALL CENTRE..

DEREK LINK
THE FACT IS YOU TEXTING A REAL PERSON. OR MORE LIKE, 700.

MATTHEW
THAT’S TRUE. WHEN WE FIRST STATED BUILDING THE PRODUCT WE THOUGHT ABOUT USING A.I… PARTNERED WITH A COMPANY HERE IN MISSOURI.

WE HAVE REAL PEOPLE RESPONDING ON THE OTHER SIDE. FEELS LIKE YOU ARE CHATTING TO A REAL PERSON, NOT JUST A ROBOT.

DEREK
BUT IT MAY NOT ALWAYS BE THE SAME PERSON REPLYING..

MATTHEW
THAT’S RIGHT.. THE REAL SECRET INGREDIENT.

DEREK
BUT YOU COULD GET A MALE TEXTING AS A GIRLFRIEND, OR THE OTHER WAY AROUND?

MATTHEW
IT DOESN’T HAPPEN AS OFTEN AS YOU MIGHT THINK.. BUT WE FOUND THAT WOMEN TEND TO MAKE BETTER BOYFRIENDS. .. IT’S SOMETHING WE’VE NOT HAD ANY COMPLAINTS AT ALL ABOUT.

DEREK LINK
ARE WE NOT SLAVES TO THESE DIGITAL DEVICES DEPENDING ON THEM MORE AND MORE TO FORM SOCIAL AND ROMANTIC CONNECTIONS.

TOBY SHAPSHAK
YES ..YOU KNOW WE’VE GO TO ACKNOWLEDGE WE LIVE IN THIS DIGITAL WORLD.

THEY’VE DONE STUDIES ABOUT HOW PEOPLE RESPOND TO TECHNOLOGY AND HOW SIMILAR IT IS TO HOW THEY RESPOND TO REAL LIFE. SO, OXYTOCIN .. PEOPLE EXPERIENCE THE SAME LEVEL AS THEY DO WHEN READING A HAPPY FACEBOOK POST AS THEY DO WHEN THEY SEE THEIR DAUGHTER.

DEREK
ARE WE HEADING TOWARDS HAVING LESS AND LESS HUMAN CONTACT IN OUR WORLD..

VUYO TEMBA
I DON’T THINK SO. ..
PEOPLE BY THEIR NATURE NEED THAT CONNECTION. THAT IS HOW WE FEED OFF EACH OTHERS ENERGIES. SO I DON’T REALLY SEE THAT WE WOULD BE HEADING FOR THAT..

DEREK
SURELY THE CONVERSATIONS WILL GET HOT AND STEAMY. IS SEXTING ALLOWED?

MATTHEW
IF YOU SEXT YOUR INVISIBLE PARTNER TOO MUCH, YOU WILL GET A TIME OUT ON THE SERVICE.. BUT IT DOESN’T HAPPEN A LOT. ..

VOICE OVER
WE ASKED ZAKARA IF SHE WOULD ASK ROY OUT ON A DATE, TO SEE WHAT WOULD HAPPEN..

ZAKARA – DIARY CAM WITH GRAPHICS OF MESSAGES

SO, I THINK I’M GOING TO ASK ROY ON A DATE OR TO GRAB A DRINK LATER…. I’M NOT SURE WHAT WILL ACTUALLY HAPPEN.

AND HE REPLIED AND SAID YES, HE WILL MEET ME FOR A DRINK AND PICK ME UP FROM WORK.. I’M NOT SURE HOW THAT WORKS..

SO I AM QUITE INTRIGUED TO SEE WHERE THIS ALL GOES.. BECAUSE OBVIOUSLY HE IS NOT GOING TO APPEAR PHYSICALLY. SO IT IS QUITE A BIZARRE CONCEPT AND INTERESTING TO GET MESSAGES THROUGHOUT THE DAY AND I’VE ASKED HIM TO SEND ME A VOICEMAIL.. SO LET’S SEE WHERE IT GOES.

DEREK
IT SOUNDS LIKE YOU WON’T BE TRYING OUT INVISIBLE GIRLFRIEND..

TOBY
I WOULDN’T. IT’S JUST ONE OF THOSE SAD STEPS OF GOING TOO FAR LIKE WEARING YOUR CROCS OUT IN PUBLIC.



PROMOS

15”
IMAGINE BEING ABLE TO DESIGN YOUR PERFECT VIRTUAL FROM THEIR NAME, TO THEIR LOOKS, WHO WILL INTERACT WITH YOU ALL DAY LONG. WELL, NOW YOU CAN ..
(VISUALS – CREATING AN INVISIBLE BF)
VUYO TEMBA
WELL, WHEN I FIRST HEARD ABOUT IT SOUNDED VERY ABSURD.
TOBY
I JUST DESPAIR..

15”
VOICE OVER
LOOKING FOR THE PERFECT BOYFRIEND OR GIRLFRIEND? WELL NOW YOU CREATE YOUR OWN VIRTUAL INVISIBLE PARTNER.
TOBY
I THINK WE ARE ALREADY TENDING TOWARDS HAVING LESS AND LESS HUMAN CONTACT AND I JUST DESPAIR THAT, THAT IS WHAT PEOPLE WILL DO. THEY WILL BECOME ACCUSTOMED TO IT AND NEVER GO OUT.

10”
MATTHEW HOMANN
THERE’S LOTS AND LOTS OF PEOPLE WHO ARE TIRED ABOUT BEING ASKED WHEN THEY ARE IN A RELATIONSHIP.
VOICE OVER: MANY OF US CAN RELATE TO THIS. BUT IS AN INVISIBLE BOYFRIEND OR GIRLFRIEND THE SOLUTION?

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): What you can do on social media knows no bounds.. One of the latest attractions is an app called Invisible Boyfriend - you can create your designer invisible boyfriend who does not exist.
metadata.Summary: PROPOSAL – INVISIBLE BOYFRIEND – 02 JULY 2015 The online world has totally changed how we date with the introduction of tinder, Grindr, Facebook and most recently invisible boyfriend and girlfriend. A dating app that allows you to create a fake partner who will text you, flirt with you and make others believe that you do in fact have a significant other. "Are you LGBT? Deployed overseas? Focusing on a promotion? An invisible boyfriend can help you manage real-world distractions," reads the FAQ section at invisibleboyfriend.com. "put simply, this platform helps you create credible, reasonable stories that you can bring home to curious mom, your buddies, and coworkers. These stories are backed by virtual and real-world social proof." Essentially, you create your own partner — everything from their name, age and where they live to their interests, character traits, and how they interact with you.The relationships offered up by these apps may be 100 per cent fake, but it's important to note that there will be a working human behind every text message, voicemail and social media post users receive from their invisible partners. For $25 you get 100 text messages, 10 voice mails and one handwritten note.
metadata.Further information: So why would you want an invisible girlfriend or boyfriend? Invisible Girlfriend and Invisible Boyfriend are the result of one man’s frustration, and a little bit of desperation. Co-founder Matt Homann was newly divorced and tired of feeling pressured to jump into something new. "Around Thanksgiving, my mom called me and asked if she should set an extra place for someone I’m bringing,” Matt recalls. “In that moment I realized how great it would be to have an answer for her that didn’t require me to actually be dating someone.” He figured he wasn't alone in that, and Invisible Girlfriend and Invisible Boyfriend was born. But beyond that, Invisible Boyfriend caters to people who don't want their conservative grandparents to find out that they're gay. Others are soldiers overseas who want to pretend they have girlfriends back home. A few others have been guys who want to practice having a girlfriend so they can see what it's like, and so they can learn how to flirt over text messages. That way, if they ever meet an actual woman, they will know what to do when it comes to texting and leaving voice mail messages and other things that people who have real boyfriends and girlfriends do.
